description: Captain Ed Mercer takes command of the Orville with Kelly Grayson as his first officer, leading a crew whose exploratory missions quickly collide with the Krill, Moclan customs, strange new societies and the awkward personal history between its commanding officers.

s01e01.description: Ed Mercer gets command of the Orville only to discover his ex-wife Kelly is his new first officer, and a routine scientific mission turns into a Krill attack over a device that can accelerate time.

s01e02.description: Ed and Kelly answer a holographic distress call and become exhibits in an alien replica of their old home, leaving Alara in command of the Orville and responsible for mounting a rescue.

s01e03.description: Bortus and Klyden discover their newborn is female, forcing the crew into a bitter clash with Moclan law and culture over whether the child should undergo sex reassignment.

s01e04.description: The Orville discovers a vast drifting bioship whose inhabitants believe their vessel is the entire universe, while Ed, Kelly and Claire try to reveal the truth before the ship reaches catastrophe.

s01e05.description: After rescuing mining captain Pria Lavesque, Ed becomes increasingly taken with her, but anomalies around the Orville expose a much stranger reason for her interest in the ship.

s01e06.description: Ed and Gordon go undercover aboard a Krill vessel to obtain a copy of the Anhkana, only to find civilians and children aboard while racing to stop an attack on a Union colony.

s01e07.description: On a world where every citizen is judged by public approval, John LaMarr's careless social mistake becomes a legal crisis and the Orville crew must understand a society governed by votes.

s01e08.description: Claire's shuttle crashes with her sons and Isaac aboard, separating her from the children while Isaac is forced into an unexpectedly parental role as the Orville searches for them.

s01e09.description: Darulio returns during delicate peace talks, but his pheromones send members of the crew into wildly irrational romantic behaviour at exactly the wrong diplomatic moment.

s01e10.description: Alara finds the ship transformed into a succession of her deepest fears, from fire to giant spiders, and must work out why the Orville itself seems to be attacking her.

s01e11.description: John's concealed intelligence comes to light and pushes him toward engineering command just as the Orville attempts to navigate an extraordinary two-dimensional region of space.

s01e12.description: Kelly's accidental contact with a primitive planet turns her into a religious figure as the world repeatedly slips through accelerated centuries, leaving the crew to confront the consequences of interference.
